summary: Officers were sent to a man lying on the ground in front of a dentist's office, under the influence and refusing to leave.
A caller asked officers to check on a 13-year-old who had been left alone for a week.
Officers chased a person on foot and searched the alleys between Lincoln, Quincy and Baker streets. One person was taken into custody while units held a perimeter for another.
Crews were sent to a structure fire reported behind a home in the 1000 block of Sumner Street.
Two vehicles collided at Heath Road and Johnson Road, and the California Highway Patrol took the call.

Officers were called to a family disturbance at a home in the 400 block of Jeffrey Street, where a caller could not get inside. Two young children were hiding in a bedroom and a grandmother was in the house.
A caller reported a man in the backyard of a home in the 1200 block of Virginia Avenue.

Officers were sent to a fight reported in front of a home in the 2700 block of Whitley Drive, with a caller reporting about 40 juveniles. One person had a cut above an eyebrow, and a neighbor reported ATVs, fireworks and possible gunshots in the area.
A caller told officers that juveniles had assaulted her in the 1000 block of Quincy Street.
Officers were called to a care facility on Meredith Drive where a juvenile had stabbed another with a fork.
Both parties in a domestic fight in a parking lot in the 2300 block of Wible Road were reported to be fighting each other, and one of them had been drinking.
Officers were called to an assault at Magnolia Avenue and Burbank Street, where a 19-year-old woman reported her brother had assaulted her.
About ten people were reported gathered over loud music in an alley behind a home in the 400 block of Highland Drive.
A man who had been throwing bottles at a home in the 1100 block of Altus Street was detained by the property owner.
Crews were sent to a grass fire east of Wasco Pond and found about an eighth of an acre burning at a slow rate of spread.
A caller reported a former tenant had returned to a property in the 1900 block of Lotus Lane and believed he had a gun, though none was seen.
A call about a crash at Truxtun Avenue and Westwind Drive turned out to be a disabled car with only three wheels on it, and a flatbed tow was requested.
Officers and medics were sent to a vehicle against a pedestrian in the 1600 block of Fremont Street.
Officers were sent to Karma Court after shots were heard in the area, and a shell casing was found on the north side of the court. A witness told officers two men had left on foot to the north.
A crew was sent to an outside fire in the center divider just north of Airport Drive and Olive Drive.
A woman locked herself in a room with a child after hearing someone in her backyard, and reported seeing a person leave with a backpack.

Officers were called to a robbery at a mini mart on the 3300 block of Wible Road. The suspect, a man in a white shirt and red pants, fled on foot with cash and a metal rod, and officers contacted a person nearby.
Officers were sent to a fight among about 20 juveniles in the 1200 block of Smith Street. A caller mentioned firearms, but none were seen, and the group dispersed.
Medics were sent to a reported stabbing on Childress Street.
A crew was sent to an outside fire under the overpass at Edison Highway and Fairfax Road.

Crews were sent to a structure fire at a 1,500-square-foot single-story home on West Moyer Avenue in Ridgecrest. The first engine found nothing showing and took command, and a second engine was diverted from a call on Highway 14 to help.
Injury crash involving car with infant and toddler.
Four people with traumatic injuries at mobile home park.
Guard shack burglary at water facility in Bakersfield.
Small fire in empty lot at Miles and Brentwood.
Officer traffic contact at 24th and Alder streets.
Small fire reported on Pacheco Road.
